model_output:
```sql
WITH university_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'ECPI University Denver'
    AND addr_city = 'Centennial'
    AND addr_state = 'CO'
    AND amenity = 'university'
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    ST_Buffer(geometry::geometry, 1200) AS buffered_geom
  FROM university_geom
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(buffered_area.buffered_geom, 4326)
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM buffered_area
  CROSS JOIN public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    ST_Transform(buffered_area.buffered_geom, 4326),
    r.rast
  )
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(clipped_rast, true)).*
  FROM raster_clip
)
SELECT 
  'ECPI University Denver, Centennial, CO' AS university_name,
  count AS area_pixels,
  sum * 0.000981 AS total_elevation_meters
FROM elevation_analysis
WHERE sum * 0.000981 >= 1700;
```
